expectedIssues: An icon is missing from the top right corner, only a red dot is visible
reportedIssues: The circular button at the top right is an empty light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot — the avatar image or icon (profile/notifications) appears to have failed to render.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') and its image and price text run off the right edge with no ellipsis or trailing gutter, making it look truncated rather than scrollable.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, with a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or gutter indicating more content.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart.
Card imagery is inconsistent: the first 'Fastest near you' card has a flat light-gray background while the others use dark, heavily blurred backgrounds, making the row look mismatched.
The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible bottom spacing, so its title and metadata are hidden and the layout feels clipped.
Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light gray text that may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast minimum.
